globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: a tailored navy-blue blazer over a crisp light-blue open-collar formal shirt, no tie (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a seamless, plain, very light ivory off-white studio backdrop (almost white, with only a faint warm tint), brightly and evenly lit from edge to edge with no falloff, no vignette, no shadows, no texture and no objects - nothing else in the frame; identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Standing upright in one spot with lively, natural open-palm hand gestures at chest height, counting points on his fingers, small confident nods and a bright smile on emphasis; hands always stay inside the frame and never in front of his face; he stays standing in the same spot, at the same distance from the camera, throughout
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, clear and energetic, continuous speech at a brisk trainer's pace, NO background music, NO sound effects, NO silence at the start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: He stays in the same spot with his face and upper body fully visible at all times; NO arms, elbows or shoulders cut off by the frame edges, NO furniture, NO bookshelves, NO plants, NO lamps, NO props, NO objects behind him, NO icons or graphics, NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, NO other people
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, vertical. A medium-wide shot: he is STANDING, framed from mid-thigh up and fairly small in the frame, so his body fills only about the middle half of the frame width with wide empty backdrop on BOTH sides of him; his shoulders, elbows and hands always stay well inside the frame and never touch its left or right edge; clear space above his head. Eye level, natural lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session against a plain ivory backdrop, NOT a furnished room. Soft, bright, even high-key light: a soft frontal key light on his face with soft fill, no harsh shadows, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Highly energetic, enthusiastic legal trainer leading a masterclass, like a motivating coach talking straight to camera to law students: bright smile, lively eyes, confident emphasis on key words, brisk clear pace, a tiny pause after each full stop; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word, never add words
